reuse.why: Keeps using getDateWithSkippedWeekend for moved occurrences, but adds the skip logic inline in getNextDate instead of next to the shared weekend helper.

duplication.why: Within getNextDate, the 'take 8 then find a non-weekend occurrence' block is written twice (forward and reverse lookup).

placement.why: getNextDate in shared/schedules.ts is a reasonable home, but getUpcomingDates (schedules/app.ts) and createScheduleList (schedule-template.ts) apply the weekend rule themselves through getDateWithSkippedWeekend and still move daily weekend dates.

scope.why: Only getNextDate and its tests change.

maintainability.why: The daily-skip rule now holds on one of the three weekend-handling paths, so the upcoming-dates list and the template's per-month walk diverge from getNextDate; the predicate is also expressed through the noSkipWeekend negations.

one_place.where: Only shared/schedules.ts getNextDate applies the daily-skip rule; server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and server/budget/schedule-template.ts still call getDateWithSkippedWeekend directly for every frequency
